tan(33 deg) = 0.6494. 33 deg is the effective friction angle of SM-SC soil (33 +/- 4, 90% limits), mid of FHWA Table 5-15 (USBR 1960, compacted inorganic soils, standard Proctor, CU triaxial); accessed 2026-11-11. Soil internal friction used as a proxy for a part sliding on ground; no source measures that. Hard surfaces (concrete, asphalt) not covered.

unverified.reason: No source measures a part or wheel on Earth's ground. Nominal and spread are tan of soil friction angles (FHWA/USBR table) used as a proxy, so both badges are estimate. Which ground the user stands on (grass, sand, clay, pavement) is unknown to the model.
